# Case IH observations

Anonymous US English storefront observations captured 2026-11-04 UTC (2026-11-03 local milestone date). The manifest records exact source URLs, observation times, original decoded-content hashes, and sanitized fixture hashes. HTML excludes executable elements, forms' input fields, hidden tokens, session attributes, and event handlers. Search JSON retains only catalog-evidence fields.

The fixtures cover sitemap and series navigation, group listing, all three search modes and empty search, five assembly pages across tractors/combines/balers, and displayed direct substitutions. All use the same `catalog.parse` and `catalog.operations` code as CASE CE. No completeness or serial-specific fitment is implied. Additional shared behavior observed here: encoded `%26` in a sitemap path, and nonorderable `NLS`/`REF` rows whose descriptions remain evidence but which have no part reference or product URL.
